scope: Reference-only decomposition of the exact immutable P2E03/P2E04/P2E06 162-case domain; no RossFast execution or discrepancy inspection, no production/reference source change, no tolerance change, no case removal or historical rewrite

internal_residual_reconstruction.interpretation: The P2E06 public candidate-state storage decomposition was not a valid proxy for the failed internal Newton iterate. In 99/103 local-balance failures the internal workspace carries a nonzero storage-rate term while the fail-closed public candidate reports zero storage change. Four states have zero internal storage-rate as well, so a universal nonzero-storage hypothesis is not supported.

estimated_floor_definition.criterion: The configured strict Reference compartment-balance criterion is not numerically distinguishable for calibration at a diagnosed state when estimated_local_floor >= configured_compartment_balance_tolerance.
estimated_floor_definition.boundary: This is a diagnostic resolution scale for the frozen experiment, not a rigorous propagated-error bound, not a replacement solver tolerance and not proof that one arithmetic operation is the sole causal mechanism.

floor_results.interpretation: The residual is produced by cancellation among much larger stored algebraic terms, but the measured final real64 summation-order and higher-precision recomposition effects are small compared with the theta input-representation scale. In all 103 states the preregistered estimated floor is therefore set by the storage-input quantization term.

distinguishable_exception.interpretation: This is the single LOCAL_BAL state in the frozen domain for which the preregistered estimated floor is below the configured 1e-12 cm/day criterion. The local failure is therefore numerically distinguishable by this diagnostic, unlike the other 102 states.

scientific_reconciliation.p2e06_public_storage_zero_interpretation: REVISED: PUBLIC FAIL-CLOSED CANDIDATE STATE MASKS THE FAILED INTERNAL ITERATE AND MUST NOT BE USED TO ATTRIBUTE THE INTERNAL RESIDUAL
scientific_reconciliation.integrated_scale: dt times estimated floor spans approximately 2.8e-16 to 1.1e-15 cm, consistent with the integrated residual-depth scale observed by P2E06.
scientific_reconciliation.reference_calibration_validity: The frozen strict 1e-12 cm/day compartment criterion is not a numerically distinguishishable calibration discriminator for 102/103 diagnosed LOCAL_BAL first-failure states under the preregistered floor model.

next_permitted_action: Run the P2E07 diagnostic, documentation and full canonical gates on the result-bearing exact head. If all pass, admit P2E07 evidence only. After admission, any replacement Reference calibration-domain construction must be a separate preregistered workunit and must not change solver tolerances or inspect RossFast discrepancies until the Reference-valid common domain is independently established.
